name: Head and Shoulders
description: A three-peak formation where the middle peak (head) is the highest, flanked by two lower peaks (shoulders) of approximately equal height. It signals the exhaustion of an uptrend and a likely reversal to the downside.
formation_rules: Price must be in a confirmed uptrend prior to pattern formation
Left shoulder forms as price rallies to a high, then pulls back
Head forms as price rallies to a higher high than the left shoulder, then pulls back to a similar trough level
Right shoulder forms as price rallies to a high roughly equal to the left shoulder, then pulls back
A neckline is drawn connecting the two troughs between the shoulders and head
The right shoulder high must be lower than the head and approximately equal to or lower than the left shoulder
The two troughs (neckline points) should be at a similar price level, within 3% of each other
volume_rules: Volume is typically highest on the left shoulder, lower on the head, and lowest on the right shoulder. A volume expansion of at least 1.5x average on the neckline breakdown candle is required for confirmation.
measured_target_method: Measure the vertical distance from the top of the head to the neckline. Project that distance downward from the neckline breakout point to get the minimum price target.
confirmation_conditions: Price closes below the neckline on a daily or weekly candle
Breakout candle volume is at least 1.5x the 20-period average volume
A retest of the neckline from below followed by rejection confirms the breakdown
RSI or MACD showing bearish divergence at the head or right shoulder strengthens the signal
invalidation_conditions: Price reclaims and closes above the neckline after the breakdown
The right shoulder forms a high that exceeds the head, invalidating the structure
Volume surges significantly on a rally back above the neckline
Price closes above the right shoulder high before a neckline break occurs

agent_rules.rule: Breakout is confirmed only when the closing price of a candle is strictly below the neckline; wicks below the neckline without a close do not constitute confirmation.
Volume on the breakout candle must be >= 1.5x the 20-period simple moving average of volume; if not met, treat the break as unconfirmed and wait for the next candle.
Pattern is invalidated when price produces a daily close above the neckline after a confirmed breakdown; cancel all bearish targets and reassess bias.
Measured target = neckline breakout price - (head high price - neckline price at the head's time); flag the target as reached when price touches or crosses it intraday.
